name: Pertinax
title: Publius Helvius Pertinax
summary: Publius Helvius Pertinax was Roman emperor for the first three months of 193, succeeding Commodus and becoming the first ruler of the turbulent Year of the Five Emperors.
notes: Reign: 2 months and 27 days. Pertinax was a self-made man who had risen from modest origins. His murder demonstrated the Praetorian Guard's power to make and break emperors. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pertinax
